#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Structured stress: dense tries, nested chains, shared starts/ends."""
import os, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/work/tmp')
import gen as G
import ref as R

BIN = '/work/submit/planb64'
T = '/work/tmp/w2'
os.makedirs(T, exist_ok=True)
fails = 0; cases = 0

def run(a): return subprocess.run(a, capture_output=True)

def write_fib(path, recs):
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        for (upper, ln, hop) in recs:
            lower = 0
            f.write("%s/%d %d\n" % (G.fmt(upper, lower, random.Random(upper ^ ln)), ln, hop))

def check(name, recs, ntrace=25):
    global fails, cases
    cases += 1
    rng = random.Random(hash(name) & 0xffff)
    fibp = T + '/f.txt'; trp = T + '/tr.txt'; img = T + '/i.idx'
    write_fib(fibp, recs)
    fx = R.parse_fib(fibp)
    G.gen_trace(trp, [(s, ln) for (s, ln, h) in fx], ntrace, rng)
    p = run([BIN, 'build', fibp, img])
    if p.returncode != 0 or p.stderr:
        print("BUILD FAIL", name, p.stderr.decode()); fails += 1; return
    want = R.serialize(R.compile_rows(fx))
    got = open(img).read()
    if got != want:
        print("IDX DIFF", name); fails += 1
        ga, wa = got.splitlines(), want.splitlines()
        print("  rows got", len(ga), "want", len(wa))
        for i in range(2, min(len(ga), len(wa))):
            if ga[i] != wa[i]: print("  row", i, "got", ga[i], "want", wa[i]); break
        return
    keys = []
    for line in open(trp).read().split('\n'):
        toks = [t for t in line.replace('\t',' ').replace('\r',' ').split(' ') if t]
        if not toks: continue
        keys.append(R.addr_upper(toks[0]))
    wantout = "".join("%d %d\n" % R.lookup_key(fx, k) for k in keys)
    for mode in ('scalar', 'batch 5', 'batch 256'):
        p = run([BIN, 'lookup', img, trp] + mode.split())
        if p.returncode != 0 or p.stdout.decode() != wantout:
            print("OUT DIFF", name, mode); fails += 1

t0 = time.time()
for trial in range(12):
    rng = random.Random(trial)
    # 1. dense binary trie over lengths 0..L
    for L in (4, 8, 12, 16):
        recs = []
        for ln in range(0, L + 1):
            for _ in range(min(1 << ln, 40)):
                start = rng.getrandbits(64) & (((1 << ln) - 1) << (64 - ln) if ln else 0)
                recs.append((start, ln, rng.randrange(0, 1 << 32)))
        # dedup
        seen = set(); rr = []
        for r in recs:
            if (r[0], r[1]) in seen: continue
            seen.add((r[0], r[1])); rr.append(r)
        check("dense%d-%d" % (trial, L), rr)
    # 2. nested chain at one start: /0,/1,/2,...,/64 all at 0
    recs = [(0, ln, ln * 7 + 1) for ln in range(0, 65)]
    check("chain%d" % trial, recs)
    # 3. nested chain at a random start
    s = rng.getrandbits(32) << 32
    recs = [(s & (((1 << ln) - 1) << (64 - ln) if ln else 0), ln, rng.randrange(1 << 32)) for ln in range(1, 65)]
    seen = set(); rr = []
    for r in recs:
        if (r[0], r[1]) in seen: continue
        seen.add((r[0], r[1])); rr.append(r)
    check("chainstart%d" % trial, rr)
    # 4. prefixes sharing starts (same start, many lengths)
    s = rng.getrandbits(64) & (0xffff000000000000)
    recs = [(s, ln, rng.randrange(1 << 32)) for ln in range(16, 65)]
    check("samestart%d" % trial, recs)
    # 5. prefixes sharing ends
    recs = []
    for ln in range(1, 40):
        end = 1 << 62
        start = end - (1 << (64 - ln))
        recs.append((start, ln, rng.randrange(1 << 32)))
    check("sameend%d" % trial, recs)
    # 6. prefixes ending exactly at 2^64 (no end event)
    recs = [((1 << 64) - (1 << (64 - ln)), ln, rng.randrange(1 << 32)) for ln in range(1, 65)]
    check("topend%d" % trial, recs)
    # 7. single /64 at the very top
    check("top64-%d" % trial, [((1 << 64) - 1, 64, 4294967295)])
    # 8. default route only
    check("def%d" % trial, [(0, 0, 5)])
    # 9. default plus sparse
    recs = [(0, 0, 9)] + [(rng.getrandbits(64), 64, rng.randrange(1 << 32)) for _ in range(30)]
    seen = set(); rr = [(0, 0, 9)]
    for r in recs[1:]:
        if (r[0], r[1]) in seen: continue
        seen.add((r[0], r[1])); rr.append(r)
    check("defsparse%d" % trial, rr)
print("cases:", cases, "failures:", fails, "secs %.1f" % (time.time() - t0))
PYEOF
